definitions.explanation: Describing something that follows the style, customs, or sensibility of an earlier era, whether positively (nostalgic, traditional) or negatively (outdated).

examples.english: I want to live in an old-style house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{喫茶店|きっさてん}→喫茶店：01079_kissaten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This café has an old-fashioned atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: My grandmother is good at making old-fashioned cooking.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ (the past, old times) and {風|ふう} (style, manner). Describes things that follow the style or customs of an earlier era. Can be either neutral/positive (nostalgic, traditional) or mildly negative (outdated) depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: old-style house
- {昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: old-fashioned flavor
- {昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: old-fashioned way of thinking
- {昔風|むかしふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: old-style lifestyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レトロ: retro — loanword with a more positive, trendy nuance; emphasizes fashionable nostalgia
- ⟦{古風|こふう}→古風：11893_kofuu⟧: old-fashioned, archaic — more literary; can suggest elegance or quaintness
- ⟦{旧式|きゅうしき}→旧式：28150_kyuushiki⟧: old-style, outdated — more negative; implies something is behind the times
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: traditional, as in the old days — emphasizes continuity from the past to the present
